summary: A cell-level block of urothelium (transitional epithelium) from a relaxed bladder: small basal cells on the basement membrane, several layers of pear-shaped intermediate cells, and large dome-shaped umbrella cells at the surface. Because only the lowest cells touch the basement membrane, it is a stratified epithelium.
clinical: Most bladder cancers arise from this lining; cigarette smoking is the main risk factor, followed by occupational aromatic amines (dye and rubber industries). The classic presentation is painless haematuria.

Chronic irritation from stones, long-term catheters or Schistosoma haematobium infection can turn urothelium into stratified squamous epithelium, which predisposes to squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder.

SubTool-1.name: Urothelial cells
SubTool-1.description: All the cells of the urothelium: small cuboidal basal cells on the basement membrane, taller pear-shaped intermediate cells above them, and large dome-shaped superficial (umbrella) cells, some with two nuclei, each covering several cells below. Umbrella cells flatten as the bladder fills, and their apical plaques of uroplakins form the barrier that keeps urine from leaking into the tissues.

SubTool-0.name: Basement membrane
SubTool-0.description: The thin sheet under the urothelium that anchors the basal cells and separates the epithelium from the lamina propria. Only the basal layer touches it, which is what makes the urothelium stratified; tumour invasion through it into the lamina propria defines stage T1 bladder cancer.

notes: Only two meshes: SubTool-1 contains every urothelial cell (basal, intermediate and umbrella cells together, about 80 cells), so the layers cannot be split into separate parts; SubTool-0 is the flat plate beneath (basement membrane). Orientation and view already match the creator's thumbnail. Some recent work argues the urothelium is really pseudostratified (thin processes reaching the basement membrane); the text follows the creator and classic teaching (stratified). Vertex colours look sRGB-encoded but are read as linear, so the model renders paler than the thumbnail; no overrides were used because they would erase the painted nuclei.
